prompt: clang-cl /Zp no value struct packing behavior
answer:
In `clang-cl`, `/Zp` **without a value means 1-byte packing**. It is translated to:

```text
-fpack-struct=1
```

This is confirmed by Clang’s driver tests and option definition. `/Zp2`, for example, becomes `-fpack-struct=2`.【https://android.googlesource.com/platform/external/clang/+/ce7e695396b9715fd06e18f7412c860a313661cd/test/Driver/cl-options.c】【https://github.com/microsoft/clang/blob/e9a52cc0/include/clang/Driver/CLCompatOptions.td】

Thus, structure members are packed with a maximum alignment of 1 byte. The MSVC documentation also states that `/Zp` without an argument packs members on 1-byte boundaries.【https://dos-help.soulsphere.org/cl.hlp/x_sl_Zp.html】

However, `clang-cl`’s implementation is not fully equivalent to MSVC: Clang’s `-fpack-struct` behavior can also change the alignment of the structure itself, whereas MSVC’s `/Zp` changes member packing but does not change the structure’s own alignment.【https://lists.llvm.org/pipermail/llvm-bugs/2020-April/082596.html】
